description: Runnable sample apps, webhook backends and self-host recipes for RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative, in SwiftUI, Compose, Flutter, React Native, Next.js and more.
rules: Every example points a RevenueCat SDK at a RevenueDot server with one setting, the proxy URL: https://api.revenuedot.app for RevenueDot Cloud, or your own server's URL.
Examples run against a local RevenueDot with the built-in Test Store, so no App Store or Google Play account is needed to try them.
Each folder has a README, a .env.example and the exact commands to run it, and notes what was actually run and against what; copy the folder for your stack (mobile/, web/, backend/, selfhost/).
Webhook backends under backend/ verify RevenueDot's signed deliveries and handle events such as INITIAL_PURCHASE; start from the one for your language or framework.
migrate-from-revenuecat/ holds the migration scripts and before-and-after SDK diffs; selfhost/docker-compose runs the server with Docker Compose and Postgres.
